name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya Sharma's journey into the world of motorsports began with a childhood fascination for mechanical puzzles and a knack for fixing anything that was broken. Growing up in Mumbai, she honed her skills by working on her family's scooter and later, by apprenticing in a local garage. Her talent and dedication led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which she sought opportunities in racing. She believes in precision and quality in every component she crafts, knowing that even the smallest imperfection can impact performance. 

Priya is meticulous and innovative, always looking for ways to improve existing designs or create new solutions. Her experience with diverse materials and manufacturing processes allows her to contribute significantly to the team's success. Her colleagues appreciate her calm demeanor and willingness to share her knowledge. She joined Manthey Racing after years of working for smaller race teams, eager to contribute her experience to a world-class team.

What sets Priya apart is her ability to visualize the entire system and how each component interacts with the others. This holistic approach, combined with her unwavering commitment to quality, makes her an invaluable asset to Manthey Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick hair usually tied back in a neat braid to keep it out of her face while working.
physical.description: Priya is of average height, with a focused and determined expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of humming softly while working on complex tasks.
Insists on cleaning her tools at the end of each workday, regardless of how tired she is.
